columns.name: EXAM DATE
columns.description: Date the licensing examination is scheduled to be administered.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Current status of the examination session (e.g., Open, Full, Cancelled, Completed).

columns.name: SEATS OPEN
columns.description: Number of examination seats currently available for registration.

columns.name: BEGINS
columns.description: Scheduled start time of the examination.

columns.name: EXAM LOCATION
columns.description: Name of the facility where the examination will be held.

columns.name: LOCATION ADDRESS
columns.description: Street address of the examination site.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: City where the examination site is located.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: State in which the examination site is located.

columns.name: ZIP CODE
columns.description: ZIP Code for the examination site.

columns.name: CAPACITY
columns.description: Maximum number of applicants that can be accommodated for the examination session.

columns.name: EXAM RESTRICTIONS
columns.description: Requirements or limitations applicable to the examination session, such as eligibility criteria, approved exam categories, or other participation restrictions.
